title: iPhone XS & XR owners: update now — Apple patched an exploited bug
description:
Apple released iOS 18.7.11 on Oct 26, 2026 for iPhone XS, XS Max and XR (and some older iPads). It fixes CVE-2026-86950, an out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics. Apple says the bug "may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack" against specific targeted individuals.

Newer devices got the same fix in iOS 26.7.1 in late September, and the US agency CISA added the bug to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Sep 29, 2026, so older iPhones waited roughly four weeks longer.

Do this: open Settings, then General, then Software Update. Then turn on Automatic Updates.

Sources
- Apple, "About the security content of iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11" (Oct 26, 2026): https://support.apple.com/en-us/149225
